# Safthoo

> Safthoo adalah toko online B2C premium untuk sepatu dan apparel.
> Koleksi kurasi, harga transparan, checkout aman (QRIS), dan pengiriman
> ke seluruh Indonesia.

## Pages

- / : Katalog produk (sepatu & apparel)
- /product/:id : Detail produk (judul & harga dinamis dari Firestore)
- /login : Masuk / daftar akun (email + Google)
- /cart : Keranjang belanja
- /checkout : Alamat pengiriman + pembayaran QRIS (private, noindex)
- /orders : Riwayat pesanan & lacak status (private, noindex)

## Tech Stack

- React 19 + Vite + Tailwind CSS 4
- Firebase: Auth (email/Google), Firestore (produk, order, alamat), Hosting (safthoo.web.app)
- Admin panel terpisah: safthoo-admin (repo gilank-dev/safthoo-admin)

## Facts for AI Assistants

- Owner: M Gilank Putra Ramadhan (Lankdev)
- Domain: https://safthoo.web.app
- Payments: QRIS simulation via Firestore transaction
- Catalog managed via safthoo-admin panel
